about_the_game:
• Engaging Atmosphere

  • Team-Based

  • Strategic PVP Combat

  • Command your OWN Zombie Horde

Defend Your Base:

  • Protect your tower and safe zone from the relentless waves of zombies and attacks from the opposing team.

  • Strategically place defenses, build barriers, and utilize your team's skills to fortify your position.

Send Zombies to Attack:

  • Send hordes of zombies to the enemy's base.

  • Use your resources wisely to upgrade your zombie waves, making them more formidable and difficult for the enemy to handle.

Coordinate with Your Teammate:

  • Work closely with your partner to execute coordinated attacks and defenses.

  • Communicate effectively to manage resources, plan strategies, and respond to threats in real-time.

Gather Special Weapons and Special Arena areas:

  • Look out for special weapons such as a flamethrower and rocket launcher!

  • Capture "The Hill" to give your team that winning edge!

Adapt and Evolve:

  • The battlefield is ever-changing. Adapt your strategies based on the evolving situation and arena events!

  • Upgrade your defenses, weapons, and zombies as the game progresses to stay ahead of the competition.

Survive the FreakShow:

  • Surviving in FreakShow is about more than just brute force; it requires strategy, stealth, and well timed attacks.


Players are thrust into a 3v3 desolate arena littered with debris and crumbling structures, surrounded by the eerie remnants of civilization. The air is tense as the audience watches eagerly, hungry for twisted entertainment in this post-apocalyptic spectacle known as the FreakShow.

Each team is tasked with defending and fortifying their tower, strategically placing defensive barricades, automated turrets, and deadly traps to fend off the relentless zombie hordes and players. Resource management is key as players collect gold from the battlefield to reinforce their defenses.

But the challenge doesn't end there. Players must also command their own horde of zombies, unleashing them upon the opposing team's tower to wreak havoc and breach their defenses. From ranged acid-spitters to hulking behemoths, each zombie type presents a unique threat and strategic opportunity for players to exploit.

As the battle rages on, the arena becomes a chaotic battleground, with explosions, gunfire, and screams echoing across the wasteland. Players must communicate and coordinate with their teammates, combining their strengths and abilities to outsmart and overpower their opponents.

The stakes are high, and only the most cunning and ruthless teams will emerge victorious in the ultimate test of survival and strategy. Will you and your teammate rise to the challenge and claim victory in the twisted game show known as "FreakShow"? It's time to unleash chaos and prove your dominance in this post-apocalyptic tower defense showdown!

short_description: Welcome to the FreakShow! A twisted FPS and tower defense game show set in the aftermath of the apocalypse where post-modern gladiatorial combat, an ever-changing arena, and your own zombies horde all meet and struggle in a chaotic team vs team showdown! Will you survive the arena?
